title: Cardinal Pellevé's secretary to Jean de Piles, abbé d'Orbais, Rome, 23 August 1589, BnF fr. 3413 no. 62

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3413 no. 62, ff. 126r-127v (Gallica btv1b52510705j, canvases 259-262)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the letter. Tomokiyo (cryptiana nevers.htm) identified the Nevers-Piles cipher and the name Cassin only.

transcription.source: Gallica full-resolution images of ff. 126v-127r (canvases 260-261), cipher runs cropped at native resolution (img/, git-ignored)
transcription.notes: no62_cipher.txt: the 14 cipher runs as sign tokens, 91 signs, measured with --measure --drop-first (22 Sept 2026). Replaces the glyph lists in solve.py.

system.summary: Tomokiyo's Nevers-Piles symbol alphabet with homophones and code signs for common words and titles, used for short runs in a clear French letter.
system.sibling_key: Tomokiyo's partial Nevers-Piles table (from fr. 3612 f. 9, not digitised) and BnF fr. 4715 f. 2 (Guise to Nevers 1586, same cipher, interlinear decipherment; ~50 words aligned in fr4715_f2_aligned.txt); both used. The three keys bound in fr. 3413 (nos. 53, 61, 69) do not fit.
system.notes: Some values disagree between Tomokiyo's table and the cribs (his b=u, m=r, 8=c; cribs give p, o, t); in fr. 4715 plain m is r, in no. 62 tailed m is o. Signs are letter-shaped glyphs, digits and graphic signs; symbol_kind approximates this mix. 22 Sept: 41 distinct signs in no. 62 (measured). Homophones confirmed: n = ◻/Ħ/H, o = tt/m(tailed)/⋕, m = ∇/x, e = θ/æ, i = 9/ħ/ɸ, u/v = ɔ/φ/b. Codes: ⌘ = Mr, Ƒ = le, n = et, ʃ = jay, 1 = de.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana nevers.htm: cipher identified as Nevers-Piles, 'Cassin' read; partial table

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: glyph annealer in clear-text context with French 6-gram LM (solve.py)

solution.what: Fetched fr. 3413 no. 62 and the three bound keys (nos. 53, 61, 69) from Gallica.
Tested the three bound keys: no. 53 numeric (letter has no figures), no. 61 Italian with other signs, no. 69 gives square = e where the letter needs n.
Tomokiyo's nevers.htm identifies the Nevers-Piles cipher and reads 'Cassin'; his partial table confirms W V ÷ 9 ◻ = Cassin.
Cribs from the clear context: 'la protection', 'vostre', signature b-a-r-o-? (Baron).
Annealed unread glyphs in their clear-text context under a French 6-gram LM (solve.py); groups too short, only the signature 'baron' stabilises.
Aligned BnF fr. 4715 f. 2 (same cipher, interlinear decipherment) word by word: confirms 4=h, 3=d, 1=de, ∇=m, += l and adds 7=d, z=b, H=n, δ=t, q=s, g=i.
With the added values: 'depeschera', '[code] mon maitre a esté retiré', 'vostre regne'; groups C, H, I and code signs ⌘ Ƒ τ ʃ unread.
Fetched fr. 3413 ff. 126-127 and fr. 4715 ff. 2r-v at full IIIF resolution from Gallica; fr. 3612 checked again on Gallica SRU: not digitised.
Re-transcribed the 14 cipher runs of no. 62 at native resolution into no62_cipher.txt (91 signs, measured). Corrections: S1 sign is θ not Ⱥ; G sign after x is ⋕ not tt; signature ends Ħ (= n).

Viewed all 29 cipher lines of fr. 4715 f. 2 and aligned ~50 words with the interlinear (fr4715_f2_aligned.txt): adds ʃ = jay, ʃ-with-bar = le, x = m, tailed m = o, a = f, n = et, ⋕ = n, o = p, d = x, ω = a, Δ = z. Full sign-by-sign transcription not completed.
Re-read Tomokiyo's nevers.htm and his Nevers-Piles table image: ⌘ = Mr, n = et, Ⱥ = f, ħ-form = i, b = u.
S2 = 'le doien'; G = 'Mr le [τ] mon maistre'; H = "j'ay veu ung advis"; I = 'confirme' (constrained word search ranks it highest among sense readings); signature Baron confirmed.
Constrained word search over C, I and V2 with the extended key (fr-gutenberg lexicon, up to 2 broken values).
Old guesses tested against the extended key: V2 gives et-f-e-g-n-e, so 'regne'/'Champaigne' fail; C gives v-o-p-a-e-?-s, no sense.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's partial Nevers-Piles table (cryptiana nevers.htm), which already identified BnF fr. 3413 no. 62 as in this cipher and read 'Cassin', was extended from the interlinear decipherment of BnF fr. 4715 f. 2 (same cipher, another letter) and from cribs in the letter's clear context.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decode62.py over no62_cipher.txt: 91 cipher signs, 75 in runs that read as sense (code signs Ƃ, ʃ, τ and runs C, V2 counted unread). Same count over the 18 Sept readings: 47/91 = 0.516.

outcome.notes: Letter substance is in clear. Cipher runs: depeschera … le doien; la protection; Cassin; vostre […]; Mr le [τ] mon maistre; j'ay veu ung advis qui confirme; Baron. Grades count cipher runs (decode62.py READ): H = protection (2 runs), Cassin, vostre, stre, Baron; C = de-pes, chera, le doien, Mr le … mon mai, j'ay veu ung advis, confirme.
